name: Auguste Ferrand
want: keep the shop open, his people safe and his son alive
secret: A German officer from the prisoner-of-war office has offered to have his son Pierre sent home from a camp in Germany, in exchange for printing work and a few names. He has not said no.
voice: Few words, growled; a veteran of Verdun who swears like one.
description: Has run the shop for thirty years and agreed to the cellar press without a speech. His son Pierre has been a prisoner of war since 1940.
appearance: Big, stooped, grey moustache yellowed by tobacco, a printer's apron over a waistcoat and a limp from the last war.

agenda.goal: decide what to do about the German offer before it is too late for Pierre
steps: meets the German officer again in a café near the Gare de l'Est
prints a job for the Germans after hours, alone

steps.text: comes to the player for advice, without telling them everything
